summary.en: Local document full-text search across your files (PDF, Office, mail, source code, ...) using Recoll / Xapian.
summary.zh-CN: 用 Recoll / Xapian 在本地全文搜索你的文档（PDF、Office、邮件、源码等）。

summary.en: Run a full-text query against the user's Recoll index. Returns matching file paths, MIME types, modification times, and snippet abstracts ranked by relevance.

why.en: Run recollq to evaluate the query against the Xapian index.
Read the local Recoll index files and config to satisfy the query.

summary.en: Run an incremental Recoll indexing pass over the configured top directories. Safe to call repeatedly; only files changed since the last run are re-indexed.

why.en: Run recollindex to walk the configured topdirs and update the Xapian index.
Read every document under the indexed top directories — Recoll walks $HOME/Documents and similar by default.
Write the updated Xapian index files.

summary.en: Report whether a Recoll index exists, when it was last updated, how many documents it contains, and which top directories are configured.

why.en: Read the Recoll config and index metadata under ~/.recoll.

label.en: Initialize Recoll config with default top directories
label.zh-CN: 用默认目录初始化 Recoll 配置

summary.en: Create ~/.recoll/recoll.conf with a sensible topdirs default (~/Documents, ~/Desktop, ~/Downloads) if no config exists yet. Idempotent: never overwrites a user-edited config.
